title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Esther 1: King Ahasuerus' great feasts in Susa, Queen Vashti's refusal, and the king's decree.

questions.text: Over how many provinces did Ahasuerus reign?
questions.explanation: Esther 1:1 says Ahasuerus reigned from India to Ethiopia, over one hundred twenty-seven provinces.

questions.text: Where was the throne of King Ahasuerus' kingdom?
questions.explanation: King Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom in Susa the palace.

questions.text: For how many days did the king display the riches of his glorious kingdom?
questions.explanation: He displayed the riches of his kingdom many days, even one hundred eighty days.

questions.text: What was the rule for the drinking at the king's feast?
questions.explanation: The drinking was not compulsory; the king had instructed his officials to let every man do as he pleased.

answers.text: Everyone had to drink with the king
No wine was served at all

questions.text: Who made a feast for the women in the royal house?
questions.explanation: Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house of King Ahasuerus.

questions.text: Why did the king want Vashti brought before him with the royal crown?
questions.explanation: He wanted to show the people and the princes her beauty, for she was beautiful.

answers.text: To ask her advice about the kingdom
To read a decree to the guests
To show the people and princes her beauty

questions.text: How did the king react when Vashti refused to come?
questions.explanation: Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment, so the king was very angry and his anger burned in him.

questions.text: Who answered the king's question about what to do with Queen Vashti?
questions.explanation: Memucan answered before the king and the princes.

questions.text: What did Memucan fear would happen when the queen's deed became known?
questions.explanation: He said all women would show contempt for their husbands when they heard the queen had refused to come.

answers.text: The provinces would rise up in revolt
The princes would leave the king
The feast would be remembered as a failure
All women would show contempt for their husbands

questions.text: What did the letters the king sent to every province say every man should do?
questions.explanation: The letters said that every man should rule his own house, speaking in the language of his own people.

answers.text: Bring his wife to the palace
Pay a tax to the king
Come to Susa for a feast
